name: computer-use-intel
description: Native desktop control for Intel (x86_64) Macs through MCP. Screenshots with exact image-to-screen geometry, compact Accessibility state, and single actions with checked postconditions. Works with GPT-6 Astra and other MCP-capable models; no model-specific API key or service required.

interface.shortDescription: Control this Intel Mac: mouse, keyboard, screen, OCR, Accessibility
interface.longDescription: Control an unlocked Intel Mac using screenshots, mouse and keyboard input, on-device OCR and Accessibility. Version 1.3 adds screenshot references, verified action loops, app identity checks and exact coordinate conversion after Retina scaling, downscaling or cropping. Native x86_64 helpers are included.
